decisions.why: framework-coverage batch 19/09/2026, Surgical Instruments framework. All 14 examples are named reusable stainless-steel instruments (Instramed Halsey Needle Holder Tungsten Carbide, Instramed Mayo Needle Holder, Instramed Halsey Needle Holder) matching the vocabulary's surgical:needle definition ("Needle holders & suture passers") exactly. None carry the 'Sterile' marker this supplier's genuinely single-use divisions use (e.g. its Forceps and Scissors divisions, both already mapped theatres:sui) — the Surgical Instruments speciality's own routeNote excludes single-use ranges as theatre consumables, so this distinction was checked before mapping.
